compliance.unsubscribe_instruction: Include a one tap stop option in every promo message and honor immediately

goals: Locate all customer chats in the chat list
Close by saying we hope to see them again
pre_checks: Confirm WhatsApp Web is loaded and the left toolbar is visible
If a reconnect banner appears click reload or follow the relink flow
Maximize viewport height for better list scanning
general_rules: Hover icons to confirm tooltips before clicking
Use the middle column for chat discovery scrolling
Scroll the thread only after a chat is open
Use ctrl k to focus search or click inside the search field

methods: Click left_toolbar.messages to show the chat list
Scroll the middle_column.content.chat_list one viewport at a time until end
For each row read the title as the customer display name
If tags or notes exist in the snippet use them for targeting
If many chats exist type known customer names into the search field and open matches
archived: Click archived_entry to open archived chats
Repeat the scan and scroll process

scroll_chat_list: repeat until target appears or end reached
scroll_thread: scroll right_canvas.thread_view to review context if needed

broadcast_flow: for each visible chat row do routine greet_and_send then proceed to next
when viewport ends run scroll_chat_list and continue until all chats processed
open archived and repeat if required
greet_and_send: compose outbound_message using message_template with variables name_from_header promo_text product_teaser and cta_short
sweep_unread_first: for each unread chat run greet_and_send
switch back to chip_all and continue

must_include: Personal greeting using the customer name
One clear sentence that explains the promotion
A friendly closing that says we hope to see you again
Stop instruction such as reply STOP to pause messages

message_template.text: Hi {{customer_name}} this is Tmizus. {{promo_text}} {{product_teaser}} Hope to see you again soon. {{cta_short}} Reply STOP to opt out.

operational_flow.step_1: Click Messages on the left toolbar
operational_flow.step_2: If you have a target segment click a filter chip or type into search
operational_flow.step_3: Scroll the chat list and select the next customer
operational_flow.step_4: Open the thread and confirm the display name at the top
operational_flow.step_5: Paste or type the message built from the template then send
operational_flow.step_6: Return to the list and continue until all customers are contacted
operational_flow.step_7: Record total sent count success count and any replies that need a human follow up

failure_recovery.click_no_effect: Retry the click after a short wait
failure_recovery.welcome_panel_visible: You are not in a thread return to the chat list and select a chat
